10090-peaceless-europe.title: Peaceless Europe
10090-peaceless-europe.creator: Francesco S. Nitti
10090-peaceless-europe.description: A book by Francesco S. Nitti. s threatened with a decline and a reversion to brutality which suggest the fall of the Roman Empire. We ourselves do not quite understand what is happening around us. More than two-thirds of Europe is in a state of ferment, and everywhere there prevails a vague sense of uneasiness, ill-calculated to encourage important collective works. We live, as the saying is, "from hand to mouth."

arxiv-2109-07404.title: Stability and dynamics across magnetic phases of vortex-bright type excitations in spinor Bose-Einstein condensates
arxiv-2109-07404.creator: G. C. Katsimiga, S. I. Mistakidis, K. Mukherjee, P. G. Kevrekidis, P. Schmelcher
arxiv-2109-07404.description: Abstract The static properties, i.e., existence and stability, as well as the quench-induced dynamics of vortex-bright type excitations in two-dimensional harmonically confined spin-1 Bose-Einstein condensates are investigated. Linearly stable vortex-bright-vortex and bright-vortex-bright solutions arise in both antiferromagnetic and ferromagnetic spinor gases upon quadratic Zeeman energy shift variations.

arxiv-2111-04846.title: Errett Bishop theorems on Complex Analytic Sets: Chow’s Theorem Revisited and Foliations of Compact Leaves on Kähler Manifolds
arxiv-2111-04846.creator: Verjovsky Alberto, Martínez Carlos Eduardo
arxiv-2111-04846.description: Abstract In this paper, we present a series of seemingly unrelated results of Complex Analysis which are, in fact, connected via a different approach to their proofs using the results of Errett Bishop of volumes, extensions, and limits of analytic varieties.

arxiv-2308-00341.title: Monitoring Algorithmic Fairness under Partial Observations
arxiv-2308-00341.creator: Thomas A. Henzinger, Konstantin Kueffner, Kaushik Mallik
arxiv-2308-00341.description: Abstract As AI and machine-learned software are used increasingly for making decisions that affect humans, it is imperative that they remain fair and unbiased in their decisions. To complement design-time bias mitigation measures, runtime verification techniques have been introduced recently to monitor the algorithmic fairness of deployed systems.

arxiv-2412-07207.title: MAPLE: A Framework for Active Preference Learning Guided by Large Language Models
arxiv-2412-07207.creator: Saaduddin Mahmud, Mason Nakamura, Shlomo Zilberstein
arxiv-2412-07207.description: Abstract The advent of large language models (LLMs) has sparked significant interest in using natural language for preference learning. However, existing methods often suffer from high computational burdens, taxing human supervision, and lack of interpretability. To address these issues, we introduce MAPLE , a framework for large language model-guided Bayesian active preference learning.

arxiv-2601-02462.title: Exposure-averaged Gaussian Processes for Combining Overlapping Datasets NestedSamplers.jl ( 31 )
arxiv-2601-02462.creator: Jacob K. Luhn, Ryan A. Rubenzahl, Samuel Halverson, Lily L. Zhao
arxiv-2601-02462.description: Abstract Physically motivated Gaussian process (GP) kernels for stellar variability, like the commonly used damped, driven simple harmonic oscillators that model stellar granulation and p-mode oscillations, quantify the instantaneous covariance between any two points. For kernels whose timescales are significantly longer than the typical exposure times, such GP kernels are sufficient.

pmc-11309385.title: Adherence to antiretroviral therapy among cisgender gay, bisexual and other men who have sex with men in Brazil: Evaluating the role of HIV-related stigma dimensions
pmc-11309385.creator: Victor C. Matos, Thiago S. Torres, Paula M. Luz
pmc-11309385.description: BackgroundIn Brazil, ~35% of people living with HIV (PLHIV) have poor adherence to antiretroviral therapy (ART). HIV-related stigma is associated with worst continuum of care outcomes, however evidence from Brazil is scarce. We explored pathways between HIV-related stigma dimensions and ART adherence among Brazilian cisgender gay, bisexual and other men who have sex with men (MSM) living with HIV.

pmc-11429449.title: GFI-YOLOv8: Sika Deer Posture Recognition Target Detection Method Based on YOLOv8
pmc-11429449.creator: He Gong, Jingyi Liu, Zhipeng Li, Hang Zhu, Lan Luo, Haoxu Li, Tianli Hu, Ying Guo, Ye Mu, Maria da Luz Mathias
pmc-11429449.description: Simple SummaryThrough gesture recognition and detection of sika deer, farmers can observe the gestures of sika deer without physical contact, providing data and technical support for the intelligent and welfare-oriented breeding of sika deer. This study is based on the YOLOv8 network model.

pmc-11709910.title: Uncovering the association between dysphagia and depression: Insights from the 2022 National Health Interview Survey
pmc-11709910.creator: Sanghee Yoo, Ickpyo Hong
pmc-11709910.description: BackgroundDysphagia can increase fear of swallowing, reduce self‐esteem, and hinder social relationships. Such factors can also increase anxiety and degrade the quality of life. This study aimed to elucidate the association between dysphagia and depressive symptoms.MethodThis study conducted an assessment of 26,810 U.S. adults using the 2022 National Health Interview Survey (NHIS) database.

pmc-13157294.title: Mental Health Burden and Associated Factors Among Patients With Leprosy After Treatment Completion in South West Delhi
pmc-13157294.creator: Suvigya Wadhwani, Nazish Rasheed, S K Rasania
pmc-13157294.description: IntroductionThe psychological sequelae of leprosy extend beyond the course of disease, yet systematic mental health evaluation in post-treatment populations remains limited, particularly within urban Indian contexts. This study examined the prevalence and determinants of depression and anxiety among leprosy patients after treatment completion in South West Delhi.

pmc-13278902.title: The stand-alone Ayurveda treatment for the management of COVID-associated mucormycosis (CAM): a case report
pmc-13278902.creator: Rajnikant Patel, Skanthesh Lakshmanan, Vinayak Padikkal, Keyur Mandaliya
pmc-13278902.description: Mucormycosis is a rapidly progressive opportunistic fungal infection predominantly affecting individuals with diabetes or immune compromise. To our knowledge, this report presents one of the first clinically documented cases of invasive Mucormycosis managed exclusively with an Ayurveda-based approach. A 60-year-old male with recent COVID-19 infection (CT severity score 7/25) presented with facial heaviness, lacrimation, and peripheral vision loss.

pmc-13330255.title: Evaluating a specialty-specific objective structured clinical examination and workplace-based assessment curriculum for radiation oncology postgraduate training: a prospective educational intervention study
pmc-13330255.creator: Chen-ying Ma, Jie Chen, Yi Fu, Lou Liu, Jing-wen Zhang, Ju-ying Zhou
pmc-13330255.description: BackgroundCompetence in radiation oncology is still commonly expected to emerge through apprenticeship, although essential tasks such as target delineation, treatment-plan review, and multidisciplinary reasoning are not reliably sampled by end-of-rotation examinations alone.MethodsWe conducted a single-center prospective educational intervention at a tertiary academic cancer center, using a historical-control comparison.

pmc-13338646.title: Nature‐Based and Community‐Level Responses to Climate Distress in Young People: A Systematic Review
pmc-13338646.creator: Meghana Bhupati, Nita Alexander, Yael Perry, Jack Farrugia
pmc-13338646.description: IntroductionClimate change is both an environmental crisis and a growing source of psychological distress for young people, calling for responses that nurture emotional resilience and collective engagement. The emerging response to climate distress has mainly focused on formal psychological and individual‐level interventions.

pmc-13392888.title: A Sustainable Approach to the Comparative Evaluation of Mechanical Surface Performance in Pigmented Paint and Transparent Varnish Systems Applied on Wood Panels
pmc-13392888.creator: Serdar Kaçamer
pmc-13392888.description: Selecting appropriate coating chemistry is essential for extending the service life of wood products and improving resource efficiency in sustainable manufacturing. This study comparatively evaluated the mechanical surface performance of transparent varnish and white pigmented paint systems applied to Eastern beech (Fagus orientalis L.) wood panels.

pmc-13581864.title: The impact of maternal hepatitis B virus infection on IVF/ICSI-assisted pregnancy outcomes: a propensity score-matched cohort study
pmc-13581864.creator: Wenwen Jiang, Suqin Zhu, Rongshan Li, Yan Sun, Xiaojing Chen, Beihong Zheng
pmc-13581864.description: BackgroundHepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is highly prevalent among women of reproductive age in China, yet whether maternal HBV carrier status affects the outcomes of assisted reproduction remains unclear. Published studies have yielded conflicting results, most were underpowered or inadequately controlled for confounders, and few have tracked outcomes beyond early pregnancy.

pmc-13694580.title: A Molecular Imaging Strategy for In Vivo Monitoring of Vascular Remodeling in a Porcine Model of Femoral Artery Overdilation
pmc-13694580.creator: Mahboubeh Nabavinia, Anjana Jayaraman, Eleanor T Rimmerman, Kumudha Narayana Musini, Corrin R Mansfield, Katherine E Mevis, Michael R Go, Mitchel R Stacy
pmc-13694580.description: PurposeClinical use of endovascular interventions has increased in recent decades for treatment of peripheral artery disease (PAD); however, molecular imaging paradigms for monitoring inflammatory responses or adverse remodeling in targeted arteries have not been validated. Therefore, this study tested the utility of positron emission tomography (PET) imaging with fluorine-18 (18F)-fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) for in vivo detection of peripheral angioplasty-induced arterial remodeling.
